first_principles_review.method: First-principles claim ledger: deconstruct claims into inputs, constraints, assumptions, evidence artifacts, and limits.

rows.irreducible_input: 3341 Show rows, 40757 Performance rows, 645 Song rows
rows.hard_constraint: Every hard foreign key resolves before analyses run
rows.soft_constraint: Venue and song slugs normalize names but do not prove real-world identity
rows.assumption: The committed archival snapshot is the publication baseline
rows.interpretation_limit: Referential completeness is not exhaustive coverage of every concert or optional layer

rows.irreducible_input: Per-show counts of ordered Performance rows, including zero-row shows
rows.hard_constraint: Empty setlists remain in the denominator
rows.soft_constraint: Set and position fields are source-derived ordering metadata
rows.assumption: A performance row is a setlist-entry unit, not a duration unit
rows.validation_artifact: performance_distribution figure dataset and distribution tests
rows.interpretation_limit: The statistic describes metadata density, not musical length or quality

rows.irreducible_input: Song performance counts after generic segment-marker exclusion
rows.hard_constraint: drums, space, tuning, feedback, and jam markers are surfaced but excluded from song rankings
rows.soft_constraint: Canonical song aliases are conservative and title-based
rows.assumption: Segment markers are set structure rather than repertoire items
rows.interpretation_limit: A high count is not a preference, importance, or aesthetic claim

rows.irreducible_input: Ranked song-performance counts and venue-show counts
rows.hard_constraint: Gini and top-decile statistics are computed from observed item counts only
rows.soft_constraint: Bootstrap intervals resample items with a fixed deterministic seed
rows.assumption: Item-level resampling is an uncertainty display, not a population model
rows.interpretation_limit: Intervals do not estimate unseen concerts or listener behavior

rows.hard_constraint: Only first-order next-song transitions are modeled
rows.soft_constraint: Permutation screening controls false discoveries for supported cells
rows.assumption: Within-show adjacency is meaningful setlist structure
rows.interpretation_limit: Transition probabilities are not causal or predictive laws

rows.hard_constraint: Only explicit source markers create segue edges
rows.soft_constraint: Unmarked adjacency remains visible in the transition model
rows.assumption: Source segue notation is sparse but semantically stronger than plain adjacency
rows.validation_artifact: segue_edges output and segue_graph figure dataset
rows.interpretation_limit: Unmarked segues and audio-continuity evidence are outside this corpus

rows.hard_constraint: Centrality uses Jaccard-normalized co-occurrence rather than raw frequency
rows.soft_constraint: Top-song heatmaps are size-limited for legibility
rows.assumption: Show-level co-presence is a useful association signal
rows.interpretation_limit: Association centrality is not influence, authorship, or musical similarity

rows.irreducible_input: Era-by-song log-count profiles with segment markers excluded
rows.hard_constraint: Centered SVD and deterministic clustering use fixed seeds and stable tie-breaks
rows.soft_constraint: Top-N songs are selected to keep labels readable at manuscript size
rows.assumption: Era-weighted count profiles can reveal inspectable repertoire neighborhoods
rows.interpretation_limit: Clusters are pattern-discovery aids, not definitive musicological taxonomy

rows.irreducible_input: Finite date poset, performance spans, and lineup intervals
rows.hard_constraint: Functor monotonicity and naturality checks are machine-evaluated
rows.soft_constraint: The abstraction preserves incidence and cumulative cardinality, not audio semantics
rows.assumption: Setlists and lineups can be modeled as finite categorical structures
rows.interpretation_limit: Formal coherence does not prove cultural or musical explanation

rows.irreducible_input: 912 venue slugs plus committed geo sidecar rows
rows.hard_constraint: Figures use only venues with resolved coordinates
rows.soft_constraint: Alias collapse is precision-oriented and intentionally incomplete
rows.assumption: Venue-level aggregation is the appropriate unit for geographic views
rows.validation_artifact: geo_scatter figure dataset; completeness venue-geo check
rows.interpretation_limit: Slug-level venue counts are lower bounds per physical building when aliases remain

rows.irreducible_input: LyricPointer URLs, curated theme tags, and sourced review sentiment rows
rows.hard_constraint: No lyric text or audio features are bundled
rows.soft_constraint: Theme and sentiment overlays are curated/partial by design
rows.assumption: Pointers can support metadata-level interpretation without reproducing protected text
rows.interpretation_limit: Overlay counts are not representative samples of all lyrics or reviews

rows.irreducible_input: Stable citation keys and cited contextual milestones
rows.hard_constraint: Contextual sources do not create Show, Performance, or Recording rows
rows.soft_constraint: Timeline milestones are selected orientation anchors
rows.assumption: Official, archival, and scholarly sources are stronger anchors than secondary summaries
rows.validation_artifact: references.bib; bibliography parser; rendered citation checks
rows.interpretation_limit: Contextual overlays explain why dates matter but do not alter computed counts

transition_sensitivity.method: deterministic descriptive sensitivity; no causal or predictive claim
